# Barrel (`equipment:barrel`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 2 gp | **Weight:** 70 lb.

A Barrel holds up to 40 gallons of liquid or up to 4 cubic feet of dry goods.
